Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4382, Claude Fable 5.2, mkinney / seat mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** I found no blocker. Each test that I ran on this head passed.

Tier: SAFETY (posted G-code). Built and tested locally on host m3, trial-merged with `upstream/main` `7da53e2a0`. No runner was used. This is the first review of this PR.

## What looks good

- `assets/posts/fanuc.cps:814` and `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps:875` write `G90 G17 G94 <wcs> G40 G49 G80`. The block comes after the notes of the section, before the tool change and before the first motion.
- Neither post writes `G93` or `G95` (I searched the two files). Thus `G94` is correct for each F word that the posts write.
- `fanuc.cps:815` sets `planeG = 17` after the block. The plane memory agrees with the word that the control read.
- The Doosan DNM post does not need that line: `restorePlane()` at the section end (`doosan-dnm.cps:956`) keeps the memory at 17.
- The new test is a module of the existing `fanuc_post` binary. It adds no top-level test binary. It has a provenance line.
- The body has the cause, the tests, "Goldens moved", "Not exercised", a `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #4346`. The decision record is `docs/decisions/4346-preamble-g17-g94.md`.
- The `crates/ui` change is one test literal. It changes no UI, thus no screenshots are necessary.
- The three "Done means" items of #4346 are met.

## Results (trial merge with `7da53e2a0`)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 867 steps planned, 867 pass, 0 failed, 0 stalled. I ran the plan in parts with `--only` (see below) |
| `cl suites: headless_bin` | pass |
| `post build` and 144 `post suites` (with `fanuc_post`, `doosan_dnm_post`, `script_fanuc`, `script_doosan_dnm`, `explain_fanuc_family`, `fanuc_mgi_blank`, `declared_options`, `comment_escape`) | pass |
| `app build` and 710 `app suites` (with `conformance`, `posting`, `setup_mount_trace`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `first_part_programs`, `program_entry`, `golden_cl`, `mcp_multiaxis_deburr_post`) | pass |
| `ui build`, `ui suites: lib` and 8 more `ui suites` | pass. The host has a GPU (Apple M3 Max, Metal) |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 6 steps, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` for `-p camcraft-post`, `-p camcraft-app`, `-p camcraft-ui` (one at a time) | clean |
| Heavy lanes | not run. This is a `P3` PR. AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" gives it no heavy step |

The quick plan ran in these parts: `post`, `app build`, `app suites` (710 suites in 6 slices), `ui`, `cl`. One slice stopped at a time limit of my session in the suite `drilling_cross_spindle`. I ran that suite again in the next slice, and it passed.

Extra suites run (recorded programs changed under `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/`, `crates/post/tests/golden/`, `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/`, `examples/` and `docs/tester-kits/`):

- each `camcraft-app` suite and each `camcraft-post` suite (in the quick plan above);
- `cargo test -p xtask catalog`: pass (26 + 6 tests).

The diff does not touch import code or `testdata/`, thus the importer suites are not owed.

## Mutations (my own; each applied, run, restored; the tree is clean again)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `fanuc.cps`: `G94` removed from the preamble, `G17` kept | red: "fanuc: the preamble `G90 G17 G54 G40 G49 G80` states G94" |
| `doosan-dnm.cps`: `G17` removed from the preamble, `G94` kept | red: "doosan-dnm: the preamble `G90 G94 G54 G40 G49 G80` states G17" |
| no mutation | green: `fanuc_post::preamble::the_fanuc_family_preamble_states_g17_and_g94_before_the_first_motion` |

These two are different from the mutations in the body. Together they show that the pin reads each word in each post.

## Goldens, line by line

I read each changed line of each recorded program with a script and by eye (`git diff -U0`).

- 77 programs change, in 100 hunks. Each hunk replaces one line with one line. The sequence number of the line, where one exists, does not change.
- 73 lines: `G90 G54 G40 G49 G80` became `G90 G17 G94 G54 G40 G49 G80`.
- 23 lines: `G90 G17 G54 G40 G49 G80` became `G90 G17 G94 G54 G40 G49 G80`.
- 1 line each: `G90 G55 ...` and `G90 G17 G55 ...` became `G90 G17 G94 G55 G40 G49 G80`.
- 2 Explain goldens: the comment is now `(ABSOLUTE POSITIONS, XY PLANE, FEED PER MINUTE)`.
- No other line of a recorded program changes. The counts agree with "Goldens moved" in the body.
- I searched the tree for a remaining program line that starts with `G90 G54` / `G90 G17 G54` and ends with `G40 G49 G80`. There is none. The remaining `G17 G90 G54 G40 G49 G80` lines are from the Mazak, Tormach and LinuxCNC posts, which this PR does not change.
- The `.camproj` files of the catalog do not change, and the three `example_catalog*` suites pass with them.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

- `crates/post/tests/golden/explain/fanuc.nc:4` and `.../explain/doosan-dnm.nc:4`: with Explain on, the comment does not name the work offset now. The 60-character cap removes `WORK OFFSET 1`. The G-code words are correct. A shorter text for one of the words can bring the work offset back.
- `assets/posts/fanuc.cps:840`: the `G17` block before `G68` now repeats the `G17` of the preamble. It is harmless.
- `assets/posts/fanuc.cps:815`: no test fails when `planeG = 17` is removed, because `restorePlane()` at each section end gives the same state. The line is a safe guard, and I do not ask for a pin.
- `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs:462`: a pair that is identical on `drill_peck` passes when only one of the two scripts posts the rotary index. That is sufficient to find a copied script. A comment that says so can help the next reader.
- #4343 tracks the same `G94` gap in the Mazak post.

## Newer main

`upstream/main` moved to `d38fd5421` during this review. `git merge-tree` gives a clean merge of this head with it. That main changes no `.cps` file and no recorded program. I did not build or test the merge with `d38fd5421`.

## Labels and state

- I set `merge-ready`. GitHub says `MERGEABLE`.
- The author is `mkinney` and the review is clean, thus I flag the PR ready (`gh pr ready 4382`).
- A push moves the head. This review then does not count for the new head.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
